description: Dutch zero-emission and low-emission zones from NDW as published: municipality, zone label, status, start, vehicle categories, transition rules, bbox centre; derived_ze_logistics is derived by AstraNL. Source recount (ids and hashes) is reported. Read-only aggregates: no permit rows, publication identifiers, titles, addresses, points or names; permit counts below 5 per authority per kind are shown as <5 and totals that would reveal one are lower bounds (>=n). Every answer carries source provenance (source, source_url, licence, as_of/retrieved_at, method, status) and an exposure block.
